mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances with low FEDFUNDS, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% over the past three months indicates a weakening labor market that reduces corporate profit growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a demand surge without corresponding supply response, generating inflationary pressures that trigger monetary tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST rises and INDPRO falls, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.1 percentage points over the past month signals aggressive monetary tightening that suppresses corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS increases by >0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) reflects robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances with high RSAFS, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 over the past three months indicates a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate output and profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a labor market that is expanding without corresponding housing demand, suggesting a potential economic misalignment that triggers equity sell-offs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises and HOUST falls, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high economic growth regimes (GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized), an increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past month signals rising inflation that prompts the Fed to tighten, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized and CPIAUCSL increases by >0.5pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
